title: Compatible affine contraction plans for 3-SAT
scope: 3-SAT, via an inherited exact counting and normalized Boolean tensor-contraction interface

positive_result.type: strict improvement of a certified cached-contractor exponent coefficient
positive_result.normalization: s/sqrt(log2(s)) in a base-two exponential, s = normalized wire budget
positive_result.decimal_values: rounded displays; exact coefficient and rational fractions control the result

verification.finite_root_certificate: exact integer elimination and exhaustive branch-bound proof
verification.schedule: exact rational packing gates and certified transcendental intervals

imported_dependencies: normalized exact tensor input interface and entry access
integral crossing modes and common-tilt entropy estimate
asymmetric nearly lossless packing and precision recurrence
fixed bilinear matrix algorithms and coefficient-ring coordinate/CRT bridge
limitations: No smaller unrestricted 3-SAT logarithmic order is proved.
No numerical per-variable SAT coefficient is inferred from the wire coefficient.
The cached construction uses subexponential space.
The result does not improve every existing time-space tradeoff.
No full solver or asymptotic matrix multiplication implementation is included.
No measured SAT runtime speedup is claimed.
Restricted envelope optima are not SAT lower bounds.
No global optimum or literature-wide novelty claim is made.
